query: Which deterministic or probabilistic registry-matching algorithm and match thresholds will we use, and how will ambiguous matches and registry non-response be resolved in sensitivity analyses?

response.query: Which deterministic or probabilistic registry-matching algorithm and match thresholds will we use, and how will ambiguous matches and registry non-response be resolved in sensitivity analyses?
response.answer: We will use a probabilistic registry-matching algorithm with predefined match thresholds. Ambiguous matches will be resolved via manual review, and registry non-response will be addressed through follow-up queries. Sensitivity analyses will adjust thresholds as needed.
